description: Search minxa, a fashion search engine, for clothes, shoes, bags, jewelry, accessories and beauty products across a broad selection of popular online shops at every price point. Describe what the person wants in plain words, in any language: the occasion, place, weather, look or budget is enough, e.g. 'something to wear to a beach wedding in Mexico' with max_price_usd 200. Returns up to 10 products with photo, price (in the shop's currency), brand, shop and a link to each product's page on minxa.com, plus a link to all results on minxa.com. minxa covers clothes, shoes, bags, jewelry, accessories and beauty products only, so do not call it for anything else.

gender.description: Whose clothes: women (minxa's default), men, or girls / boys for kids. Set it from the request: "men's linen shirts" is men, "something for my daughter" is girls; leave it out when the request doesn't say whose. Left out, minxa searches women's unless the words say whose, as minxa.com does; the answer's gender is the one searched.

max_price_usd.description: Highest price in US dollars. When set, items the shop prices in another currency are left out.

query.description: What the person wants, in plain words and in any language: the item itself, or the occasion, place, weather, look and budget it is for (e.g. 'something to wear to a beach wedding in Mexico'), plus any colour, material or brand.

name: search_fashion_products

disclosure.description: How minxa is paid (null when nothing matched).

fallback.description: Present only when the full search was busy and these are the newest items in the category the query names.

currency.description: ISO code as stored, e.g. USD, GBP, AUD.

price.description: In `currency`, as the shop lists it; never converted.

price_text.description: The price as minxa.com prints it.

minxa_search_url.description: All results for this search on minxa.com (null when nothing matched).

no_match.description: Present only when nothing minxa has matches the request: it is not a fashion or beauty product.

total_matches.description: Cards minxa.com shows for this search (each colour is a card).

title: Search minxa fashion
